source.robots: https://epoch.ai/robots.txt allows /data/ (disallows /assets/, /inspect-viewer/ and the FrontierMath problem pages).

notes: 81 benchmark CSV files: 14 Epoch runs (no _external suffix) and 67 external compilations with per-row Source/Source link columns (some external files have none).
benchmark_metadata.csv covers 60 of them (in_eci, score column, release date, superseded_by); 21 newer files have no metadata row.

External rows are Epoch's copies of results other organisations published. Terms of the original project apply to those numbers; Benchmark Heaven publishes a number from its origin, not from an aggregator copy, unless the origin is unreachable and its terms allow reuse (DeepSWE precedent, iteration 76).
ECI itself (epoch_capabilities_index/) is collected separately by scripts/fetch-epoch-eci.mjs; this inventory is about the individual boards.
